Gees Gwardafuy.name: Gees Gwardafuy
Gees Gwardafuy.description: Also known as Cape Guardafui, this headland at Somalia's northeastern tip overlooks the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean near a historic shipping route.

Wright Island.name: Wright Island
Wright Island.description: A large, ice-covered Antarctic island along the Bakutis Coast of Marie Byrd Land, surrounded by remote ice shelves and polar seas.

Grant Island.name: Grant Island
Grant Island.description: An ice-covered island off Antarctica's Marie Byrd Land, almost encircled by the Getz Ice Shelf and named after a U.S. Navy commander.

Newman Island.name: Newman Island
Newman Island.description: A long, ice-covered island embedded in Antarctica's Nickerson Ice Shelf off the coast of Marie Byrd Land.

Dean Island.name: Dean Island
Dean Island.description: A remote Antarctic island surrounded by the Getz Ice Shelf, between Grant Island and Siple Island off Marie Byrd Land.

Cape Canaveral.name: Cape Canaveral
Cape Canaveral.description: A sandy cape on Florida's Atlantic coast, internationally known for NASA's Kennedy Space Center and generations of space launches.

Cape Mendocino.name: Cape Mendocino
Cape Mendocino.description: A rugged headland on Northern California's Pacific coast, near the tectonically active Mendocino Triple Junction.

Cabo San Lucas.name: Cabo San Lucas
Cabo San Lucas.description: A coastal headland and resort area at the southern tip of Mexico's Baja California Peninsula, famous for dramatic granite sea arches.

Cape Churchill.name: Cape Churchill
Cape Churchill.description: A remote headland on the western shore of Hudson Bay in Manitoba, Canada, known for polar bear habitat and Arctic coastal tundra.

Cape Cod.name: Cape Cod
Cape Cod.description: A hook-shaped peninsula extending into the Atlantic from Massachusetts, celebrated for sandy beaches, fishing villages, and maritime history.

Cape May.name: Cape May
Cape May.description: A historic seaside cape at New Jersey's southern tip, where Delaware Bay meets the Atlantic and migratory birds gather.

Cabo de Hornos.name: Cabo de Hornos
Cabo de Hornos.description: Cape Horn is a storm-exposed headland on Hornos Island in southern Chile, long regarded as a landmark of treacherous ocean navigation.

Cape of Good Hope.name: Cape of Good Hope
Cape of Good Hope.description: A rocky promontory near Cape Town, South Africa, famous for dramatic cliffs and its place in the history of ocean trade.

Cape Palmas.name: Cape Palmas
Cape Palmas.description: A headland on Liberia's southeastern Atlantic coast near Harper, marking a prominent turn in West Africa's shoreline.

Cape Verde.name: Cape Verde
Cape Verde.description: Also called Cap-Vert, this Atlantic peninsula around Dakar, Senegal, is the westernmost point of mainland Africa.

Cap Bon.name: Cap Bon
Cap Bon.description: A peninsula and headland in northeastern Tunisia projecting into the Mediterranean, with fertile countryside, beaches, and historic coastal towns.

Oceanic pole of inaccessibility.name: Oceanic pole of inaccessibility
Oceanic pole of inaccessibility.description: Known as Point Nemo, this remote South Pacific location lies farther from any land than any other place in the world's oceans.

South Magnetic Pole 2005 (est).name: South Magnetic Pole 2005 (est)
South Magnetic Pole 2005 (est).description: An estimated 2005 position of the shifting South Magnetic Pole near Antarctica, where Earth's magnetic field points vertically upward.

North Magnetic Pole 2005 (est).name: North Magnetic Pole 2005 (est)
North Magnetic Pole 2005 (est).description: An estimated 2005 position of the moving North Magnetic Pole in the Canadian Arctic, where Earth's magnetic field points vertically downward.

Lands End.name: Lands End
Lands End.description: Land's End is a dramatic granite headland at the western end of Cornwall, England, overlooking the open Atlantic Ocean.

Cape York (Greenland).name: Cape York (Greenland)
Cape York (Greenland).description: An Arctic cape on Greenland's northwestern coast, associated with the Thule region and the historic Cape York meteorite discoveries.

Nunap Isua.name: Nunap Isua
Nunap Isua.description: Also known as Cape Farewell, this rocky headland on an offshore island marks Greenland's southernmost extremity.

Cape Vohimena.name: Cape Vohimena
Cape Vohimena.description: Also called Cape Sainte Marie, this windswept cape marks Madagascar's southern tip and protects distinctive dry coastal habitat.

Vavau.name: Vavau
Vavau.description: Vavaʻu is an island group in northern Tonga, renowned for sheltered bays, coral reefs, and humpback whales that visit seasonally.

I. de Pascua.name: I. de Pascua
I. de Pascua.description: Easter Island, or Rapa Nui, is a remote Chilean island in the Pacific known for its monumental moai statues and Polynesian culture.

Cape Agulhas.name: Cape Agulhas
Cape Agulhas.description: The southernmost point of the African mainland, where the Atlantic and Indian oceans are conventionally said to meet.

Plain of Jars.name: Plain of Jars
Plain of Jars.description: An archaeological landscape in Laos containing thousands of ancient stone jars scattered across upland plains, with their original purpose still debated.

Cabo Corrientes (North America).name: Cabo Corrientes (North America)
Cabo Corrientes (North America).description: A rocky headland on Mexico's Pacific coast south of Puerto Vallarta, forming the southern edge of Banderas Bay.

Pt. Eugenia.name: Pt. Eugenia
Pt. Eugenia.description: Punta Eugenia is a headland on Baja California's Pacific coast in Mexico, beside productive waters and the offshore islands of Sebastián Vizcaíno Bay.

Point Conception.name: Point Conception
Point Conception.description: A prominent headland on California's Santa Barbara County coast, where the shoreline bends sharply and ocean conditions often change.

Cape Hatteras.name: Cape Hatteras
Cape Hatteras.description: A shifting barrier-island headland on North Carolina's Outer Banks, famed for its lighthouse, surf, and hazardous offshore shoals.

Cape Sable (North America).name: Cape Sable (North America)
Cape Sable (North America).description: A low-lying cape at the southwestern edge of mainland Florida, overlooking the Gulf of Mexico within Everglades National Park.

Cape Hope.name: Cape Hope
Cape Hope.description: A headland on the northern shore of Scoresby Sound in eastern Greenland, close to the former settlement of Kap Hope.

Point Barrow.name: Point Barrow
Point Barrow.description: The northernmost point of the United States, extending into the Arctic Ocean near Utqiaġvik, Alaska.

Punta Negra.name: Punta Negra
Punta Negra.description: A coastal point on the Pacific-facing shores of South America, named for the dark appearance of its rocky headland.

Punta Lavapié.name: Punta Lavapié
Punta Lavapié.description: A rocky point and fishing settlement on Chile's Biobío coast, commanding views across the Gulf of Arauco toward Santa María Island.

Punta Galera.name: Punta Galera
Punta Galera.description: A prominent headland in southern Chile's Los Ríos Region, marked by an historic lighthouse above the Pacific Ocean.

Cap Lopez.name: Cap Lopez
Cap Lopez.description: A low, sandy headland near Port-Gentil, Gabon, at the mouth of the Ogooué River where its waters meet the Atlantic.

Cape Bobaomby.name: Cape Bobaomby
Cape Bobaomby.description: Also called Cap d'Ambre, this windswept headland forms the northernmost tip of Madagascar.

Cap Blanc.name: Cap Blanc
Cap Blanc.description: A desert headland on the Mauritania–Western Sahara coast near Nouadhibou, notable for rocky shores and endangered Mediterranean monk seals.

South West Cape.name: South West Cape
South West Cape.description: A remote, wind-battered cape on Tasmania's southwestern coast, facing the Southern Ocean within a wild protected landscape.

Cape Howe.name: Cape Howe
Cape Howe.description: A coastal headland near the Victoria–New South Wales border in southeastern Australia, bordered by beaches and heathland.

Cape Otway.name: Cape Otway
Cape Otway.description: A rocky cape on Victoria's southern coast, where a historic lighthouse stands above the waters of Bass Strait.

Cape Jaffa.name: Cape Jaffa
Cape Jaffa.description: A low coastal headland in South Australia near the Coorong, historically important as a navigation landmark and lighthouse site.

Cape Carnot.name: Cape Carnot
Cape Carnot.description: A rugged headland on the southern tip of South Australia's Eyre Peninsula, southwest of Port Lincoln.

Cape Byron.name: Cape Byron
Cape Byron.description: Australia's easternmost mainland point, near Byron Bay in New South Wales, distinguished by a lighthouse and sweeping ocean views.

Cape Manifold.name: Cape Manifold
Cape Manifold.description: A coastal headland on Queensland's Capricorn Coast, marking part of the shoreline north of the Tropic of Capricorn.

Cape York (Australia).name: Cape York (Australia)
Cape York (Australia).description: The northernmost point of mainland Australia, at the tip of Queensland's Cape York Peninsula overlooking Torres Strait.

Cape Melville.name: Cape Melville
Cape Melville.description: A remote granite headland on northeastern Queensland's coast, adjoining a national park known for isolated rainforest and unique wildlife.

Cape Arnhem.name: Cape Arnhem
Cape Arnhem.description: A coastal headland in Australia's Northern Territory, on the eastern side of the Gove Peninsula in the Yolŋu homelands.

West Cape Howe.name: West Cape Howe
West Cape Howe.description: A rugged headland on Western Australia's south coast, known for cliffs, coastal bushland, and views of the Southern Ocean.

Cape Leeuwin.name: Cape Leeuwin
Cape Leeuwin.description: Australia's southwesternmost mainland cape, near Augusta, where the Indian and Southern oceans are commonly considered to meet.

Cape Pasley.name: Cape Pasley
Cape Pasley.description: A remote rocky headland along Western Australia's southern coast, overlooking wild beaches and the Great Australian Bight region.

Cape Londonderry.name: Cape Londonderry
Cape Londonderry.description: The northernmost point of Western Australia, projecting into the Timor Sea from the Kimberley coastline.

Steep Point.name: Steep Point
Steep Point.description: The westernmost point of mainland Australia, a dramatic cliff-edge headland on the Indian Ocean coast of Western Australia.

North West Cape.name: North West Cape
North West Cape.description: A peninsula on Western Australia's Indian Ocean coast near Exmouth, adjacent to Ningaloo Reef and its abundant marine life.

Cabo Gracias a Dios.name: Cabo Gracias a Dios
Cabo Gracias a Dios.description: A low-lying headland on the Caribbean coast at the Nicaragua–Honduras border, near the mouth of the Coco River.

Cape Brewster.name: Cape Brewster
Cape Brewster.description: A steep, basalt-walled cape in eastern Greenland on the southern side of the entrance to Scoresby Sound.

Cape Morris Jesup.name: Cape Morris Jesup
Cape Morris Jesup.description: The northernmost point of Greenland's mainland, a remote Arctic cape overlooking the Lincoln Sea.

Grímsey.name: Grímsey
Grímsey.description: A small island north of Iceland crossed by the Arctic Circle, known for seabird colonies and fishing traditions.

Surtsey.name: Surtsey
Surtsey.description: A volcanic island south of Iceland formed during eruptions from 1963 to 1967 and protected for research into ecological colonization.

Cap Est.name: Cap Est
Cap Est.description: A headland on Madagascar's northeastern coast near Antalaha, where tropical vegetation meets the Indian Ocean.

Cape Cretin.name: Cape Cretin
Cape Cretin.description: A headland on Papua New Guinea's northern coast near Lae, overlooking the Huon Gulf.

Îles Chesterfield.name: Îles Chesterfield
Îles Chesterfield.description: A remote group of coral reefs and sandy islets in the Coral Sea, associated with New Caledonia and important to nesting seabirds.

Pagan.name: Pagan
Pagan.description: A volcanic island in the Northern Mariana Islands, with active volcanic terrain rising above the western Pacific Ocean.

Wake I..name: Wake I.
Wake I..description: Wake Island is a small coral atoll in the northern Pacific, known for its strategic airfield and World War II history.

Tabiteuea.name: Tabiteuea
Tabiteuea.description: A long, narrow coral atoll in Kiribati's Gilbert Islands, made up of villages along low-lying islets and lagoon waters.

Aranuka.name: Aranuka
Aranuka.description: A small coral atoll in Kiribati's Gilbert Islands, distinguished by its unusual triangular lagoon and coconut-lined islets.

Nauru.name: Nauru
Nauru.description: A tiny island country in the central Pacific, known for its raised coral plateau and history of phosphate mining.

Ebon.name: Ebon
Ebon.description: A low-lying coral atoll in the southern Marshall Islands, with a broad lagoon enclosed by a ring of islets.

Jaluit.name: Jaluit
Jaluit.description: An atoll in the Marshall Islands with historic importance as an administrative and trading center during the colonial era.

Mili.name: Mili
Mili.description: A coral atoll in the Marshall Islands, with numerous islets, extensive lagoon waters, and World War II remains.

Majuro.name: Majuro
Majuro.description: A large atoll and the capital area of the Marshall Islands, where narrow coral islands surround a sheltered lagoon.

Ailinglapalap.name: Ailinglapalap
Ailinglapalap.description: A broad coral atoll in the Marshall Islands, consisting of low islets around a lagoon and long-established island communities.

Kwajalein.name: Kwajalein
Kwajalein.description: One of the world's largest coral atolls by lagoon area, in the Marshall Islands, with islands used for defense and space tracking.

Rongelap.name: Rongelap
Rongelap.description: A remote Marshall Islands atoll affected by radioactive fallout from U.S. nuclear testing in 1954, with a history of displacement and resettlement efforts.

Bikini.name: Bikini
Bikini.description: A Marshall Islands atoll internationally known for U.S. nuclear tests conducted there and the lasting environmental and human consequences.

Cape Reinga.name: Cape Reinga
Cape Reinga.description: A sacred headland at the northern end of New Zealand's North Island, where Māori tradition links the land with departing spirits.

Kanton Island.name: Kanton Island
Kanton Island.description: A large coral atoll in Kiribati's Phoenix Islands, noted for its expansive lagoon and historic role in trans-Pacific aviation.

Tabuaeran.name: Tabuaeran
Tabuaeran.description: Also called Fanning Island, this inhabited coral atoll in Kiribati's Line Islands has a lagoon and low palm-covered land.

Malden Island.name: Malden Island
Malden Island.description: A remote, uninhabited island in Kiribati's Line Islands, known for seabirds, prehistoric Polynesian remains, and former guano extraction.

Rarotonga.name: Rarotonga
Rarotonga.description: The largest and most populous island of the Cook Islands, with volcanic peaks, tropical forests, and a surrounding fringing reef.

Rangiroa.name: Rangiroa
Rangiroa.description: One of the world's largest atolls, in French Polynesia's Tuamotu Archipelago, known for an immense lagoon and rich marine life.

Funafuti.name: Funafuti
Funafuti.description: The capital atoll of Tuvalu, with slender coral islets surrounding a lagoon and communities vulnerable to rising seas.

Saint Croix.name: Saint Croix
Saint Croix.description: The largest of the U.S. Virgin Islands, featuring Caribbean beaches, historic Danish colonial towns, and coral reefs.

Grand Cayman.name: Grand Cayman
Grand Cayman.description: The largest Cayman Island, known for Seven Mile Beach, clear Caribbean waters, and George Town's financial and tourism activity.

San Salvador.name: San Salvador
San Salvador.description: A low-lying Bahamian island with reefs, inland lakes, and historical associations with Columbus's first Caribbean landfall.

Grenada.name: Grenada
Grenada.description: A mountainous Caribbean island and country known for spice cultivation, tropical forests, and sheltered bays.

Barbuda.name: Barbuda
Barbuda.description: A low-lying Caribbean island belonging to Antigua and Barbuda, known for pink-tinted beaches and a major frigatebird colony.

Antigua.name: Antigua
Antigua.description: The larger island of Antigua and Barbuda, famous for its many sheltered harbors, beaches, and historic English Harbour.

Guadeloupe.name: Guadeloupe
Guadeloupe.description: A French Caribbean island group centered on mountainous Basse-Terre and flatter Grande-Terre, featuring rainforests and volcanic landscapes.

Dominica.name: Dominica
Dominica.description: A mountainous Caribbean island nation known for dense rainforests, hot springs, and dramatic volcanic scenery.

Martinique.name: Martinique
Martinique.description: A French Caribbean island with volcanic highlands, tropical beaches, and cultural influences from Africa, Europe, and the wider Caribbean.

Saint Lucia.name: Saint Lucia
Saint Lucia.description: A volcanic Caribbean island nation best known for the twin Pitons, tropical forests, and scenic bays.

Saint Vincent.name: Saint Vincent
Saint Vincent.description: The main island of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, dominated by the active La Soufrière volcano and lush mountain terrain.

Barbados.name: Barbados
Barbados.description: An eastern Caribbean island nation known for coral-limestone landscapes, beaches, and a long history of sugar cultivation.

Tobago.name: Tobago
Tobago.description: The smaller main island of Trinidad and Tobago, celebrated for forested hills, coral reefs, and the historic Main Ridge rainforest reserve.

Margarita.name: Margarita
Margarita.description: A Venezuelan island in the Caribbean Sea known for dry hills, sandy beaches, fishing communities, and coastal towns.

Curaçao.name: Curaçao
Curaçao.description: A Dutch Caribbean island with colorful Willemstad architecture, dry landscapes, and sheltered coves rich in marine life.

Aruba.name: Aruba
Aruba.description: A low-lying Dutch Caribbean island just off Venezuela, noted for white beaches, arid hills, and constant trade winds.

Ra’s Banäs.name: Ra’s Banäs
Ra’s Banäs.description: A long headland on Egypt's Red Sea coast, extending toward coral-rich waters near the southern part of the country.

Ponta das Salinas.name: Ponta das Salinas
Ponta das Salinas.description: A prominent headland on Angola's Atlantic coast southwest of Benguela, marked by a lighthouse used in coastal navigation.

Ponta das Palmeirinhas.name: Ponta das Palmeirinhas
Ponta das Palmeirinhas.description: A headland south of Luanda, Angola, on the Atlantic coast, with a lighthouse overlooking a stretch of sandy shoreline.

Cabo Bojador.name: Cabo Bojador
Cabo Bojador.description: A cape on the Atlantic coast of Western Sahara, historically feared by sailors before early Portuguese voyages rounded it.

Cape Comorin.name: Cape Comorin
Cape Comorin.description: Also called Kanyakumari, the southernmost tip of mainland India, where the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Indian Ocean converge.

Dondra Head.name: Dondra Head
Dondra Head.description: The southernmost point of Sri Lanka, near Matara, known for its prominent lighthouse overlooking the Indian Ocean.

Cape Yelizavety.name: Cape Yelizavety
Cape Yelizavety.description: A northern headland of Sakhalin Island in Russia's Far East, facing the cold waters of the Sea of Okhotsk.

Pt. Yuzhnyy.name: Pt. Yuzhnyy
Pt. Yuzhnyy.description: A coastal point in Russia's Far East; its Russian name means 'southern point' and reflects its position on the shoreline.

Cape Sata.name: Cape Sata
Cape Sata.description: The southernmost cape on Japan's Kyushu mainland, overlooking waters that connect the Pacific Ocean and East China Sea.

Cape Aniva.name: Cape Aniva
Cape Aniva.description: A remote cape at the southeastern tip of Sakhalin, Russia, near the weather-beaten Aniva Lighthouse.

Cape Terpeniya.name: Cape Terpeniya
Cape Terpeniya.description: A long, narrow cape projecting from eastern Sakhalin Island into the Sea of Okhotsk in Russia's Far East.

Cape Lopatka (Asia).name: Cape Lopatka (Asia)
Cape Lopatka (Asia).description: The southern tip of Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula, across the First Kuril Strait from the northern Kuril Islands.

Cape Ozernoy.name: Cape Ozernoy
Cape Ozernoy.description: A remote headland on Kamchatka's eastern coast in Russia, facing the North Pacific and Bering Sea region.

Cape Olyutorskiy.name: Cape Olyutorskiy
Cape Olyutorskiy.description: A headland in northeastern Kamchatka, Russia, projecting into the Bering Sea and marking the edge of Olyutorsky Bay.

Cape Navarin.name: Cape Navarin
Cape Navarin.description: A prominent headland on the Bering Sea coast of Chukotka, Russia, known for strong winds and rugged shorelines.

Cape Ince.name: Cape Ince
Cape Ince.description: A geographic headland recorded in Turkey under the name İnce Burun, meaning 'narrow cape.'

Ra’s Fartak.name: Ra’s Fartak
Ra’s Fartak.description: A dramatic coastal headland in eastern Yemen overlooking the Arabian Sea, with high cliffs rising above the shoreline.

Ras Sharbatat.name: Ras Sharbatat
Ras Sharbatat.description: A headland on Oman's Arabian Sea coast, in a sparsely populated area of cliffs, beaches, and desert terrain.

Ra's al Had.name: Ra's al Had
Ra's al Had.description: A headland at the eastern tip of Oman, near important sea turtle nesting beaches where the Gulf of Oman meets the Arabian Sea.

Hachijō-jima.name: Hachijō-jima
Hachijō-jima.description: A volcanic island south of Tokyo in Japan's Izu Islands, known for subtropical scenery, hot springs, and ocean views.

Nordkapp.name: Nordkapp
Nordkapp.description: North Cape is a famous cliff on Norway's Magerøya island, overlooking the Barents Sea and a popular destination for midnight-sun visitors.

Cabo de São Vicente.name: Cabo de São Vicente
Cabo de São Vicente.description: A windswept headland at Portugal's southwestern corner, where a historic lighthouse overlooks the Atlantic Ocean.

Cabo Fisterra.name: Cabo Fisterra
Cabo Fisterra.description: A dramatic cape on Galicia's Atlantic coast in Spain, historically considered the end of the known world by some travelers.

Cape San Blas.name: Cape San Blas
Cape San Blas.description: A sandy headland on Florida's Gulf Coast, known for its beaches, dunes, and historic lighthouse.

Cape Bauld.name: Cape Bauld
Cape Bauld.description: A headland at the northern tip of Newfoundland, Canada, overlooking the Strait of Belle Isle and Labrador Sea waters.

Cape Fear.name: Cape Fear
Cape Fear.description: A prominent cape on the coast of North Carolina, near the mouth of the Cape Fear River and the notorious Frying Pan Shoals.

I. Guadalupe.name: I. Guadalupe
I. Guadalupe.description: Guadalupe Island is a remote volcanic island off Baja California, Mexico, famous for endemic species and surrounding great white shark habitat.

Miquelon.name: Miquelon
Miquelon.description: An island in the French territory of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, near Newfoundland, linked to Langlade by a sandy isthmus.

I. Robinson Crusoe.name: I. Robinson Crusoe
I. Robinson Crusoe.description: A rugged volcanic island belonging to Chile's Juan Fernández Archipelago, named after the novel inspired by a marooned sailor's experience there.

Cabo Orange.name: Cabo Orange
Cabo Orange.description: A coastal cape in northern Brazil near the border with French Guiana, bordering the mangrove-rich wetlands of Cabo Orange National Park.

Cabo de Santa Marta Grande.name: Cabo de Santa Marta Grande
Cabo de Santa Marta Grande.description: A headland on Brazil's southern coast in Santa Catarina, known for its lighthouse and views over the Atlantic.

Punta del Este.name: Punta del Este
Punta del Este.description: A resort peninsula on Uruguay's Atlantic coast, where beaches meet the waters of the Río de la Plata estuary.

Cabo San Antonio.name: Cabo San Antonio
Cabo San Antonio.description: A sandy headland on Argentina's Buenos Aires Province coast, forming the outer edge of Samborombón Bay.

Cabo Corrientes (South America).name: Cabo Corrientes (South America)
Cabo Corrientes (South America).description: A rocky headland on Argentina's Atlantic coast at Mar del Plata, near beaches, cliffs, and urban waterfronts.

Punta Rasa.name: Punta Rasa
Punta Rasa.description: A low coastal point in Argentina's Buenos Aires Province, where the Río de la Plata meets the Atlantic and migratory shorebirds gather.

Cabo Dos Bahías.name: Cabo Dos Bahías
Cabo Dos Bahías.description: A rocky headland and wildlife reserve on Argentina's Chubut coast, known for seabirds and nearby penguin colonies.

Cabo Delgado.name: Cabo Delgado
Cabo Delgado.description: A headland on northern Mozambique's Indian Ocean coast near the border with Tanzania, giving its name to Cabo Delgado Province.

Ponta da Barra.name: Ponta da Barra
Ponta da Barra.description: A headland near Inhambane in southern Mozambique, bordered by reefs and beaches at the entrance to Inhambane Bay.

Ponta São Sebastio.name: Ponta São Sebastio
Ponta São Sebastio.description: A coastal point on São Tomé island near the capital, São Tomé, associated with the historic São Sebastião fort.

Ras Cantin.name: Ras Cantin
Ras Cantin.description: Also called Cap Beddouza, this Atlantic headland on Morocco's coast is a notable navigational landmark near Safi.

Ra’s Kasr.name: Ra’s Kasr
Ra’s Kasr.description: A headland on the Red Sea near the Sudan–Eritrea border, marking a coastal point in a sparsely populated region.

Ponta de Jericoacoara.name: Ponta de Jericoacoara
Ponta de Jericoacoara.description: A sandy coastal point in Ceará, Brazil, known for dunes, beaches, and the nearby village of Jericoacoara.

Cabo de São Roque.name: Cabo de São Roque
Cabo de São Roque.description: A headland in northeastern Brazil near Natal, marking a prominent bend in the Atlantic coastline.

Ponta da Baleia.name: Ponta da Baleia
Ponta da Baleia.description: A coastal point in southern Bahia, Brazil, near the Abrolhos marine region, visited seasonally by humpback whales.

Cabo de São Tomé.name: Cabo de São Tomé
Cabo de São Tomé.description: A low headland in Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil, surrounded by sandy Atlantic shores and coastal lagoons.

Cabo Frio.name: Cabo Frio
Cabo Frio.description: A rocky Atlantic headland in Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil, known for cool ocean upwelling and clear coastal waters.

Cabo San Diego.name: Cabo San Diego
Cabo San Diego.description: A remote headland at the southeastern tip of Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego, Argentina, overlooking the South Atlantic.

Cabo Tres Puntas.name: Cabo Tres Puntas
Cabo Tres Puntas.description: A cape on Argentina's southern Patagonian coast, projecting into the Atlantic amid rugged shoreline and open steppe.

Cap Saint André.name: Cap Saint André
Cap Saint André.description: A headland on Madagascar's western coast, extending into the Mozambique Channel near broad tidal flats and mangroves.

Cape St. Lucia.name: Cape St. Lucia
Cape St. Lucia.description: A coastal headland on South Africa's KwaZulu-Natal shore, near the iSimangaliso Wetland Park and a historic lighthouse.

Cape St. Francis.name: Cape St. Francis
Cape St. Francis.description: A headland and coastal village on South Africa's Eastern Cape coast, known for surf, beaches, and the Seal Point Lighthouse.

Minamitori-shima.name: Minamitori-shima
Minamitori-shima.description: An isolated coral island administered by Japan, far east of the main Japanese islands and surrounded by the open Pacific.

Islas de Martín Vaz.name: Islas de Martín Vaz
Islas de Martín Vaz.description: A tiny, remote Brazilian island group in the South Atlantic, consisting of steep rocky islets east of Trindade Island.

Rockall.name: Rockall
Rockall.description: A tiny, isolated granite outcrop in the North Atlantic, west of Scotland and Ireland, surrounded by deep ocean and disputed maritime claims.

I. de Cozumel.name: I. de Cozumel
I. de Cozumel.description: Cozumel is a Caribbean island off Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula, internationally known for coral reefs and scuba diving.

Bermuda Islands.name: Bermuda Islands
Bermuda Islands.description: A subtropical Atlantic archipelago and British Overseas Territory, known for pink-sand beaches, limestone caves, and maritime history.
